subject: POC Environment Onboarding: MAP Milestones & Tech Dependencies
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@ableco.com>, Ops Team <ops@ableco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC Environment Onboarding: MAP Milestones & Tech Dependencies

Thanks for the call this morning — quick post-call recap and proposed MAP milestone owners so we can get the POC environment ready by the target date. I pasted a short milestone table and the asks underneath. Please reply with an ownership + ETA (date) next to each item so we can lock the schedule.

Summary (target): POC ready for runbook tests by 2026-06-21; MAP close targeted EOW 2026-06-25

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) VPC peering setup (network connectivity) — owner: AbleCo network / Redwood cloud infra
   - Dependencies: AWS account IDs, CIDR ranges, peering approvals, route table updates
   - Ask: please send AWS account ID(s) & primary VPC CIDR by EOD 2026-06-03

2) IP allowlist / firewall rules — owner: AbleCo security / Redwood SRE
   - Dependencies: list of outbound egress IPs (Redwood will provide ours), and any internal firewall windows
   - Ask: confirm if you need fixed egress IPs or a CIDR block; if IPs, provide place-holder acceptance window and contact

3) SSO / SAML integration (admin access) — owner: AbleCo identity team / Redwood IAM
   - Dependencies: SAML metadata, IdP attributes mapping, SCIM or manual user provisioning decision
   - Ask: share SAML metadata file + point person (Name/email) for IdP testing by 2026-06-07

4) Secrets & KMS (keys for traffic/encryption) — owner: AbleCo security / Redwood security
   - Dependencies: decision on customer-managed KMS vs. Redwood-managed keys, KMS key ARN(s) if customer-managed
   - Ask: confirm preferred KMS approach and provide list of required key ARNs (if customer) by 2026-06-09

5) Test accounts & credentials — owner: Redwood (provisioning) / AbleCo (approval)
   - Dependencies: SSO/IdP access or service account keys, IP allowlist completed, role mapping

Attachments I'll reference: poc-map-draft.pdf (MAP with milestone dates), redwood_egress_ips.txt (egress ranges), and our checklist template.

Open questions from call:
- Do you require on-prem NAT traversal or just AWS VPC peering?
- Will procurement require an MSA amendment for the POC? (cc'ing procurement)

Next steps
- Alice / Ops: confirm owners & provide artifacts (AWS IDs, SAML metadata, procurement cadence)
- Redwood (Marissa/Sean/Dev): provision temporary environment and share firewall IPs
- Target: final MAP sign-off by 2026-06-07 so engineering can schedule the peering window

Thanks — I can jump on a quick 15m call tomorrow if helpful.

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

[Attachment: poc-map-draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

Subject: Re: POC Environment Onboarding: MAP Milestones & Tech Dependencies

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on milestones and I've added owners below. Attaching the initial network artifacts.

- VPC peering / Network owner: Alice Wu (Network Lead) — alice.wu@ableco.com — ETA: 2026-06-05 for AWS account & CIDR confirmation
- IP allowlist / Firewall: Security Ops (contact: ops@ableco.com) — will review egress needs; ETA: 2026-06-06
- SSO / IdP: Identity Team (Samir Patel, samir.patel@ableco.com) — attaching SAML metadata, will do first test on 2026-06-08
- Secrets/KMS: Security Architecture (procurement + sec arch to coordinate) — procurement looped for KMS decision; expect initial stance by 2026-06-09

Attachments (stubs):

Notes: Security has asked for a short runbook of steps Redwood will perform during peering (we can use your MAP doc). Procurement: cc'ing procurement@ for contract path on the POC (term length and attribution).

Thanks — Alice
Alice Wu

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-03T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: POC Environment Onboarding: MAP Milestones & Tech Dependencies — Confirmed owners & next steps

Thanks Alice — appreciate the quick owners & artifacts. Below is an updated MAP milestone list with owners, tentative ETAs, and our asks. Please confirm or propose changes inline. If we can get sign-off on owners by 2026-06-07 we can schedule the peering window for the following week.

Updated MAP (action owners + ETAs):
- VPC peering (owner: Alice Wu / AbleCo Network) — AWS IDs & CIDR provided (thanks), ETA for peering setup: 2026-06-10
  - Redwood action: create peering request week of 2026-06-08; provide peering runbook to AbleCo (Marissa owner)

- IP allowlist (owner: Ops Team / AbleCo) — ETA to approve Redwood egress list: 2026-06-06
  - Redwood action: provide final egress list and test window (Marissa)

- SSO / SAML (owner: Samir Patel / AbleCo Identity) — ETA first test: 2026-06-08
  - Ask: please confirm exact attribute mapping and whether SCIM will be required for the POC

- Secrets & KMS (owner: Security Architecture / Procurement) — Decision ETA: 2026-06-09
  - Ask: confirm if you will provide customer-managed KMS (if yes, provide ARNs) or accept Redwood-managed keys for POC

- MAP sign-off target: 2026-06-07 (so engineering schedules peering for 6/8–6/10)

If this looks good I'll convert the draft into a formal MAP (single PDF) and send for signature/approval to procurement.

Thanks everyone — I added procurement@ableco.com to this thread for contract-related next steps.

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
